dogecoin.text: Bitcoin is clearly unstable. Switching to Dogecoin for my imaginary money needs.

Given how the tech industry (along with game dev) burns through neurodivergent people like coal clinkers to crunch code out, I can guarantee you that epic Asperger's Dogecoin meme man is personally responsible for a lot of autistic people who are about a decade prematurely aged.

SNL needed Trump so badly so it could rely on him and his orbiting dipshit cloud for content. Now they have to fully suck up to the people in charge, and they're reduced to letting le epic meme CEO on to do Dogecoin infomercials. Absolutely punished.

It's the same quasireligious internet psychology as believing that you meme-magicked Trump into office with image board posts, instead of Clinton not campaigning in Wisconsin or Michigan. Dogecoin is being pumped-and-dumped, but that's not so fun to think about.
Accidentally butt-dialing a $14100 charge in my Tesla after sinking most of my liquidity into a Dogecoin/Gamestop portfolio.
